name: huit-servicenow-dev
description: Ask Claude about ServiceNow records through HUIT's hosted snow-mcp server, dev tier: incidents, changes, requests, catalog items, CMDB, people and groups, knowledge, approvals, attachments, history, any table you can see in the UI. Read-only; every call runs as you with your own ServiceNow ACLs. Authentication is a ServiceNow (HarvardKey SSO) login in your browser through /mcp; no token, client ID, or secret. Requires the HUIT cloudadmin VPN. Temporary: the production server will be published in harvard-huit/huit-plugin-marketplace.
